_comment: Copy this to .claude/hooks/dependencies.json and replace the entries with your own.

the file the agent is about to EDIT. Each value is the list of files it must have
READ in this session first. Globs use fnmatch, so `*` does not stop at a slash:
Declare the couplings that have actually bitten you. A map with four honest
